desc: Newspaper Publication regarding 25th AGM of the Company.
Announcement under Reg 30 of SEBI (LODR) Reg, 2015

This is with reference to the Annual Report for the FY 2025-26 submitted by the Company on September 3, 2026, pursuant to the applicable listing regulations.

We regret to inform you that the 'Independent Auditors Certificate on Corporate Governance' was inadvertently omitted from the Annual Report 2025-26 due to an oversight. We request you to please read the original submission along with the below mentioned correction:

Page Number: 101
Heading: Independent Auditors Certificate on Corporate Governance
Corrected Information: Inserted the Independent Auditors Certificate on Corporate Governance in page no. 101.

Apart from the omission mentioned above, there are no other changes to the Annual Report or the Financial Statements submitted on September 3, 2026. The revised version of the Annual Report incorporating this change has been uploaded to the Company's website at a weblink at https://www.starcement.co.in/pdf/annual-reports/Annual-Report-2025-26.pdf and also enclosed herewith.
